remarks: ***Call for Offers: March 10th @ 5PM*** Waterfront living just feels better at Schooner Cove. Tucked into Shippan, minutes to downtown Stamford, Metro North, I-95, beaches, parks, and waterfront restaurants, yet set right on the marina where life slows down a notch. Morning coffee by the water, quick commute to the city, sunset walks along the docks, it is all right outside your door. The community offers a private marina, pool, beautifully maintained grounds, and an association that covers heat and water, making ownership refreshingly simple. Inside, a welcoming entry leads into freshly painted space with new carpet and a brand new kitchen that feels sharp, modern, and ready to go. The kitchen opens to the dining and living area where a wood burning fireplace anchors the room and the marina views steal the spotlight. Step out to your private balcony and the water becomes part of everyday life. Two bedrooms and two full bathrooms are thoughtfully positioned for privacy, including a primary suite. Upstairs, the loft adds flexible space for a home office, den, or guest setup. Your dream of waterfront living, done right.
